svg.aria-label: An isometric ink drawing. The hub is a great tortoise standing on a paved slab: one always-on machine that works today on its own. Planned: three elephants stand on its shell, your other machines, each running its own agents; amphorae on planks on their backs are workloads, two on the left elephant, one on the middle, and a dashed jar lands on the right one because a job moves to the node that has room; a smaller elephant on its own slab walks up to join when it comes online.

g.text: planned · each runs its own agents
a job moves to the node that has room
one always-on machine that carries every node
works today on its own: it runs its agents and work itself
